description: Research-informed essays about psychology, history, power, identity, and the systems shaping human behavior.
about: I'm Syra Mashek, a provisionally licensed alcohol and drug counselor (PLADC) and graduate student in Clinical Mental Health Counseling at Wayne State College. I write about what happens when psychology, history, social structures, and the complexities of human experience meet. This is a space for curiosity, critical thinking, and research that doesn't have to live behind academic jargon.
